play_plan.meaning: Gear 2 is lost (will not engage). The engineer tells the driver which gear is gone or stuck, so he knows what to avoid.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Player's car only, in a race, on track, after the gearbox fault is total on gear 2 and the notice delay has passed. Not after the finish, in the pit lane, or when wrecked/stopped.
play_plan.trigger: RACE_ACTIVE 0x007D0308 != 0 (gear_failure.c in_session); RACE_PHASE 0x007C56A8 > 4 and gear_player_ontrack() (live_drive); fault_is_total(g_ctl) (gear_failure.c:908); fault_gear(g_ctl) == 2 (gear_failure.c:919); mode not STUCK/BOTH (gear_failure.c:1586); COMMENTARY_ON 0x005EA618+0xAF0 != 0 (gear_failure.c:89); (now - g_locked_at) >= g_notice_delay (gear_failure.c:1580); !gear_wrecked_or_stopped() (gear_failure.c:978). Pit phase for 'in-lap / out-lap / flying': in-lap = pit_status veh+0x3450 == 1 or call_to_box; out-lap = first lap after pit_status 4->0; flying = neither (coordinator rule c, DERIVED).
play_plan.subject: player (-1; VEH_BASE = mfc_player_base(), slot 0 or CO-OP local human). AI not used by this line.
play_plan.technique: lift_suppression: unblock eid 81 FLT_MAX -> 15 s (unblock_gear_clips gear_failure.c:412, call l.1408) + own_emitter: queue_eid writes the real eid to Q_HEAD (gear_failure.c:421).
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per fault (g_announced=1); 15 s cooldown after unblock (CLIP_COOLDOWN gear_failure.c:11); pump gives up after 20000 ms (CLIP_TIMEOUT_MS).
play_plan.must_not_play_when: RACE_ACTIVE == 0 (qualifying or menus; SESSION_TYPE 5 never plays); stint_over (finish or pit); wrecked or stopped; fault not total (warning phase: a missed shift is not a failure); live_drive false (line DROPPED, never deferred); COMMENTARY_ON 0; replay; AI cars.
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 never rewrites event rows (coordinator rule b): the cooldown lift is a dev-only write. The only MF-token conflict is 'do not queue while an MF line is pending on eid 81' (DD-07). Native TV twin 340 (native PitTimer path, scheduler UNKNOWN) may play the same clip on TV if its path runs.
play_plan.calibration: g_notice_delay = 5000 + (r/7)%7000 ms (gear_failure.c:1552); g_hud_delay 1000-2999 ms (l.1551); CLIP_TIMEOUT 20000 ms. Measure with the gear_failure_log 'clip eid=81 PLAYED after Xms' lines.

play_plan.meaning: Gear 5 is lost (will not engage). The engineer tells the driver which gear is gone or stuck, so he knows what to avoid.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Player's car only, in a race, on track, after the gearbox fault is total on gear 5 and the notice delay has passed. Not after the finish, in the pit lane, or when wrecked/stopped.
play_plan.trigger: RACE_ACTIVE 0x007D0308 != 0 (gear_failure.c in_session); RACE_PHASE 0x007C56A8 > 4 and gear_player_ontrack() (live_drive); fault_is_total(g_ctl) (gear_failure.c:908); fault_gear(g_ctl) == 5 (gear_failure.c:919); mode not STUCK/BOTH (gear_failure.c:1586); COMMENTARY_ON 0x005EA618+0xAF0 != 0 (gear_failure.c:89); (now - g_locked_at) >= g_notice_delay (gear_failure.c:1580); !gear_wrecked_or_stopped() (gear_failure.c:978). play_plan.must_not_play_when: RACE_ACTIVE == 0 (qualifying or menus; SESSION_TYPE 5 never plays); stint_over (finish or pit); wrecked or stopped; fault not total (warning phase: a missed shift is not a failure); live_drive false (line DROPPED, never deferred); COMMENTARY_ON 0; replay; AI cars.

play_plan.meaning: Gear 1 is stuck (cannot change out of it). The engineer tells the driver which gear is gone or stuck, so he knows what to avoid.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Player's car only, in a race, on track, after the gearbox fault is total on gear 1 and the notice delay has passed. Not after the finish, in the pit lane, or when wrecked/stopped.
play_plan.trigger: RACE_ACTIVE 0x007D0308 != 0 (gear_failure.c in_session); RACE_PHASE 0x007C56A8 > 4 and gear_player_ontrack() (live_drive); fault_is_total(g_ctl) (gear_failure.c:908); fault_gear(g_ctl) == 1 (gear_failure.c:919); mode STUCK or BOTH (gear_failure.c:1584); COMMENTARY_ON 0x005EA618+0xAF0 != 0 (gear_failure.c:89); (now - g_locked_at) >= g_notice_delay (gear_failure.c:1580); !gear_wrecked_or_stopped() (gear_failure.c:978). Pit phase for 'in-lap / out-lap / flying': in-lap = pit_status veh+0x3450 == 1 or call_to_box; out-lap = first lap after pit_status 4->0; flying = neither (coordinator rule c, DERIVED).
play_plan.subject: player (-1; VEH_BASE = mfc_player_base(), slot 0 or CO-OP local human). AI not used by this line.
play_plan.technique: lift_suppression: unblock eid 87 FLT_MAX -> 15 s (unblock_gear_clips gear_failure.c:412, call l.1408) + own_emitter: queue_eid writes the real eid to Q_HEAD (gear_failure.c:421).
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per fault (g_announced=1); 15 s cooldown after unblock (CLIP_COOLDOWN gear_failure.c:11); pump gives up after 20000 ms (CLIP_TIMEOUT_MS).
play_plan.must_not_play_when: RACE_ACTIVE == 0 (qualifying or menus; SESSION_TYPE 5 never plays); stint_over (finish or pit); wrecked or stopped; fault not total (warning phase: a missed shift is not a failure); live_drive false (line DROPPED, never deferred); COMMENTARY_ON 0; replay; AI cars.
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 never rewrites event rows (coordinator rule b): the cooldown lift is a dev-only write. The only MF-token conflict is 'do not queue while an MF line is pending on eid 87' (DD-07). Native TV twin 377 (unknown producer) may play the same clip on TV if its path runs.
play_plan.calibration: g_notice_delay = 5000 + (r/7)%7000 ms (gear_failure.c:1552); g_hud_delay 1000-2999 ms (l.1551); CLIP_TIMEOUT 20000 ms. Measure with the gear_failure_log 'clip eid=87 PLAYED after Xms' lines.
play_plan.live_test: 1) Dev DLL only: open development/mods/mechanical_failures/mech_test_panel.bat (not mech_test_gui.bat), pick the 'Stuck in 1st gear' line (eid 87) and press Test line (cmd_say -> say_eid, gear_failure.c:1516). 2) Check gear_failure_log.txt for 'clip eid=87 PLAYED after'. 3) Real race: Options > Realism > Mechanical Failures = normal, drive until a total gearbox fault on gear 1; the line should come about 5-12 s after the fault is total.
play_plan.confidence: DERIVED (static) + mod source CONFIRMED; PLAYED stamps in owner log for eids 81/83/87/89/90 only; no ear-check for any of the 10. Raise to CONFIRMED: ear-check each eid via Test line, and confirm the installed build carries the gear code.

play_plan.meaning: Gear 4 is stuck (cannot change out of it). The engineer tells the driver which gear is gone or stuck, so he knows what to avoid.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Player's car only, in a race, on track, after the gearbox fault is total on gear 4 and the notice delay has passed. Not after the finish, in the pit lane, or when wrecked/stopped.
play_plan.trigger: RACE_ACTIVE 0x007D0308 != 0 (gear_failure.c in_session); RACE_PHASE 0x007C56A8 > 4 and gear_player_ontrack() (live_drive); fault_is_total(g_ctl) (gear_failure.c:908); fault_gear(g_ctl) == 4 (gear_failure.c:919); mode STUCK or BOTH (gear_failure.c:1584); COMMENTARY_ON 0x005EA618+0xAF0 != 0 (gear_failure.c:89); (now - g_locked_at) >= g_notice_delay (gear_failure.c:1580); !gear_wrecked_or_stopped() (gear_failure.c:978). Pit phase for 'in-lap / out-lap / flying': in-lap = pit_status veh+0x3450 == 1 or call_to_box; out-lap = first lap after pit_status 4->0; flying = neither (coordinator rule c, DERIVED).
play_plan.subject: player (-1; VEH_BASE = mfc_player_base(), slot 0 or CO-OP local human). AI not used by this line.
play_plan.technique: lift_suppression: unblock eid 90 FLT_MAX -> 15 s (unblock_gear_clips gear_failure.c:412, call l.1408) + own_emitter: queue_eid writes the real eid to Q_HEAD (gear_failure.c:421).
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per fault (g_announced=1); 15 s cooldown after unblock (CLIP_COOLDOWN gear_failure.c:11); pump gives up after 20000 ms (CLIP_TIMEOUT_MS).
play_plan.must_not_play_when: RACE_ACTIVE == 0 (qualifying or menus; SESSION_TYPE 5 never plays); stint_over (finish or pit); wrecked or stopped; fault not total (warning phase: a missed shift is not a failure); live_drive false (line DROPPED, never deferred); COMMENTARY_ON 0; replay; AI cars.
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 never rewrites event rows (coordinator rule b): the cooldown lift is a dev-only write. The only MF-token conflict is 'do not queue while an MF line is pending on eid 90' (DD-07). Native TV twin 380 (unknown producer) may play the same clip on TV if its path runs.
